notes: Consolidated multi-step flow into single page with form at top and study checklist below
Simplified study list to checkbox + title layout (removed borders, gender, age, status, compensation)
Clicking study title now toggles its checkbox instead of linking to study details
Removed Continue button and Back to Studies navigation — single Submit button for the whole form
Removed study filters (Sex, Age) — all studies now shown without filtering
Made email field optional — defaults to noemail@cenexel.com when left empty
Replaced Date of Birth date picker with Month, Day, and Year dropdowns (Year is required, Month and Day are optional)
Replaced Azure Service Bus submission with SendGrid email delivery
Lead emails sent as HTML table to configurable recipient via CENEXEL_LEAD_EMAIL constant
Requires SENDGRID_API_KEY and CENEXEL_LEAD_EMAIL constants in wp-config.php
author: CenExel
